emotionalArc: Anxiety about repeating the same year shifts through agitation to aspiration as Money Boost reveals its modules, then climbs through proof to urgent, triumphant motivation to act now.

transition.description: Opening scene: hard cut placeholder. Dark night frame, glowing phone light on a tired face; on-screen '2026 ARRIVE' punches in centered.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Stop the scroll by confronting the viewer with the fear of ending another year unchanged.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: 2026 is coming — will you end it in the same place again?

scenes.script: Deux mille vingt-six arrive. Vas-tu encore finir l'année au même point ?

transition.description: Hard cut from dark to a bright light background; giant '365 JOURS' number scales up fast and fills the vertical frame.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Compress the stakes into a single shocking number that frames time as the asset being wasted.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: You have exactly 365 days to change everything.

scenes.script: Trois cent soixante-cinq jours pour tout changer.

transition.description: Vertical split-screen slides in: top half scrolling and spending, bottom half managing and investing; bicolor 'SUBIR ou BOOSTER ?' lands on the seam.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Agitate by contrasting passive drift against active control, forcing a binary self-identification.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Most people wait for the right moment that never comes.

scenes.script: Chaque année, des milliers attendent le bon moment. Il ne vient jamais.

transition.description: Camera pushes through the split toward center as the 'MONEY BOOST 2026' logo assembles; module names appear one by one stacked below.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Reveal the brand as the answer and cascade its five modules to establish breadth of value.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Money Boost turns the year into income across five domains.

scenes.script: Avec Money Boost, transforme l'année en revenus : business en ligne, finances, investissement, intelligence artificielle.

transition.description: Benefit lines slide up and stack one after another on the same surface; 'STRATÉGIES CONCRÈTES', 'OUTILS', 'ACCOMPAGNEMENT', 'COMPÉTENCES RENTABLES' build the eye downward.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Translate the modules into tangible, money-making outcomes the viewer can picture owning.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Concrete methods and tools that turn skills into money.

scenes.script: Des méthodes concrètes, des outils prêts, un accompagnement pas à pas. Et surtout : transformer tes compétences en argent.

scenes.sceneName: PREUVE SOCIALE — ILS L'ONT DÉJÀ FAIT

transition.description: Confident faces and result snapshots slide in as a quick grid; bold 'ILS L'ONT DÉJÀ FAIT' overlays, eye landing on the headline.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Prove the promise is real by showing others already succeeded, then hand the choice to the viewer.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Others already boosted their income — now it's your turn.

scenes.script: Ils ont déjà boosté leurs revenus. À toi de jouer.

transition.description: Hard cut to a hand clicking 'REJOINDRE MAINTENANT', then full-screen end card on solid bicolor blue/orange: 'PLACES LIMITÉES' to 'INSCRIPTIONS OUVERTES', signature line below.

narrativeIntent.narrativeRole: Convert with scarcity and a single clear command, sealed by the transformation promise.
narrativeIntent.keyMessage: Limited spots — click the link and join Money Boost now.

scenes.script: Places limitées. Clique sur le lien et rejoins Money Boost maintenant. Transforme deux mille vingt-six en année de revenus.
